kjv: cut down the grove that is by it (the altar of Baal)
mine: cut down the Asherah that is beside it (the altar of Baal)
note: 'asherah is a cult pole or image of the goddess Asherah, not a grove; the KJV follows the Septuagint/Vulgate "grove". Also in vv. 26, 28, 30.

kjv: Take thy (Gideon's) father's young bullock, even the second bullock
mine: Take your (Gideon's) father's young bull, and the second bull
note: The Hebrew is difficult; it is unclear whether one or two bulls are meant.
One of the few places where the KJV transliterates the divine name.

kjv: the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon
mine: the spirit of Yahweh clothed Gideon
note: labshah means "clothed (itself with)"; Gideon becomes the garment the spirit wears. "Came upon" loses the image.

kjv: upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place
mine: on top of this stronghold, with the stones laid in proper order
note: ma'oz means stronghold and bamma'arakhah means "in proper arrangement"; the KJV's "ordered place" is vague.
